Name: RoseDryad's Mushroom Flower Grass for More Grass
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
[b]Spring: [/b]Purple flowers, pink flowers, and mushroom grass.
[b]Summer: [/b]Pink flowers, lavender flowers, and mushroom grass.
[b]Fall:[/b] White flowers, mushroom grass, and plain grass.

To remove a grass type, just delete the image file in the season's folder. To increase the spawn rate of a grass type, duplicate the image file.

The default grass is disabled by default. After you start the game with the mod installed, a config.json file will be created. To enable the default grass, open the config.json inside the mod folder with Notepad and change the word "false" to "true". 

Note: More Grass packs are compatible with other grass packs that use the framework so you can install as many as you want.
